title: 飞卡 FlyCard · v0.4 Demo
creator: takeda_iori
direct_result: The direct GitHub Pages game loaded into a card-table deployment phase. Initially Chinese; the in-game English button translated the live state to “Round 1 · Table” and “Your turn: hold the card, drag backwards, release to slide.”
actions: Opened the exact playable URL in a new isolated Brave Work tab; waited for the game board to render.
Clicked the Ace of Hearts card once; the game responded “drag too short — hold the card and pull it back, then release.”
Dragged the Ace vertically; the card moved onto the table, and the next screenshot showed the AI King of Spades card entering the board.
Dragged the Ace horizontally backward to launch it toward the opponent; the cards moved across the tabletop and the AI card moved in response.
Waited for the next turn; the game displayed “Your turn: hold the card, drag backwards, release to slide.”
Clicked the English button; it reported “Switched to English” and displayed “Round 1 · Table.”
gameplay_response: Mouse drag inputs moved the Ace across the table; the game then introduced and moved the AI's King card. After the motion settled, the game returned to a visibly identified player turn. This is direct game-state response, not a menu-only check.
mechanics_evidence: Observed two-player card-table duel using physics-like drag-and-release shots. The card is pulled backward and released to slide across the table; the AI card moves in response. Current visible turn/phase was Round 1 · Table.
art_evidence: No separate cover image was found in the page's OG metadata or image elements. The direct game has custom minimalist art: a large green felt tabletop, cream playing cards with Ace/King suits, gold selection rings, and a compact Player/AI round HUD. This is game-specific playable art but not a separate promotional thumbnail.

thumbnail_concepts.label: A
thumbnail_concepts.concept: Cinematic close-up of the Ace of Hearts whipping across a rich green felt table toward a looming King of Spades, motion trail and a tight gold target ring; preserve the clean card-table art and keep the player-versus-AI matchup readable at thumbnail size.

thumbnail_concepts.label: B
thumbnail_concepts.concept: Top-down dramatic near-collision: Ace and King cards spinning toward one another across the felt, one bright gold impact point and subtle shadows; use the actual card faces and restrained cream/green/gold palette without adding unsupported score text.

audio_note: The parent-verified system output mute covered this test; no game/browser/system audio setting was changed.
source: existing AI Game Scout; candidate manifest in ../run.json
test_mode: direct candidate URL and canvas gameplay; no AddictingGames iframe test
browser_isolation: new Brave Work tab created for this test; pre-existing user tabs were not touched
screenshot_note: Inline CUA screenshots captured the initial card, AI King response, and moved card positions. This browser interface did not provide a file-persistence method for screenshot bytes.
